response.sql: WITH account_stats AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 as region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') THEN t.amount END) as avg_amount, AVG(t.balance) as avg_balance FROM trans t INNER JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), region_stats AS (SELECT region, AVG(avg_amount) as region_avg_amount, AVG(avg_balance) as region_avg_balance FROM account_stats GROUP BY region), global_mean AS (SELECT AVG(region_avg_amount) as global_avg_amount FROM region_stats) SELECT r.region, r.region_avg_amount, r.region_avg_balance, r.region_avg_amount / g.global_avg_amount as amount_ratio FROM region_stats r CROSS JOIN global_mean g WHERE g.global_avg_amount IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: Accounts with no PRIJEM or VYDAJ transactions are included in per-region averages (with NULL average amount, ignored by AVG function), rather than excluded entirely.
